name: EFVault v4 upgrade storage-layout collision
summary: The EFVault v4.0 implementation installed on the ENF USDC vault proxy inserted a new assetDecimal variable at the storage slot that v3.0 used for maxDeposit, without re-initialising it. assetDecimal therefore read the old 5,000,000 USDC maxDeposit value, and the new redeem() priced shares with assetsPerShare() = totalAssets * assetDecimal * 1e18 / totalSupply, inflating each share by roughly five million times. A depositor redeemed 676,562 share units (about 0.69 USDC of value) twice for 5.16m USDC withdrawn from the controller's strategies.

loss.notes: Exact USDC paid out by the vault controller 0xf491afe5101b2ee8abc1272fa8e2f85d68828396 in the two successful redeem calls (source-1 and source-5): 5,155,406.505541 USDC to the attacker-named receiver plus 5,160.567071 USDC withdrawal fee to 0x39f4ef6294512015ab54ed3ab32baa1794e8de70; the fee is part of depositor depletion and is not deducted. The attacker's fair entitlement for the 1,353,124 burned share units at pre-upgrade pricing is about 1.38 USDC and is not subtracted. Internal strategy unwinds (cUSDC, cDAI, Curve 3pool, COMP) are intermediate legs, not additional loss.

ageReset.description: Third and last pre-exploit Upgraded event: the project Safe 0x66945268093f28c28a2dce11a1640e06c070df7b, via ProxyAdmin 0xd06ef24eb2da8b3e5a042da39ec303dd9162e0a6 upgrade(proxy, impl), installed EFVault v4.0 0x80cb73074a6965f60df59bf8fa3ce398ffa2702c, whose layout places assetDecimal on the slot holding v3.0 maxDeposit. The EIP-1967 implementation slot still holds it at block 16696239.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age history. Source-1 is a direct EOA call by 0xa0959536560776ef8627da14c6e8c91e2c743a0a to proxy 0xbdb515028a6fa6cd1634b5a9651184494abfd336, redeem(uint256,address) selector 0x7bde82f2, shares 0xa52d2 = 676562, receiver 0x8b5a8333ec272c9bca1e43f4d009e9b2fad5efc9; receipt log 105 burns those 676562 units and logs 103/104 move 3440.359688 + 3436919.328971 USDC from controller 0xf491afe5101b2ee8abc1272fa8e2f85d68828396. Storage layout (OpenZeppelin upgradeable bases occupy slots 0..200): v3.0 0x582010c270ef877031e6b16554e51ca5bbda882e declares asset(201), depositApprover(202), controller(203), maxDeposit(204), maxWithdraw(205), paused(206); v4.0 0x80cb73074a6965f60df59bf8fa3ce398ffa2702c declares asset(201), depositApprover(202), controller(203), assetDecimal(204), maxWithdraw(205), maxDeposit(206), whiteList(207), paused(208) and assigns assetDecimal only in initialize(), which cannot rerun. eth_getStorageAt slot 204 = 0x48c27395000 (5e12, the v3 maxDeposit) at both blocks 16696142 and 16696239; slots 206-208 are 0 at 16696239. At block 16696239 controller.totalAssets(false) = 6880910594692 and totalSupply() = 6765625454275, so v4 assetsPerShare() = 6880910594692*5e12*1e18/6765625454275 and redeem returns shares*assetsPerShare/1e24 = 3440359688659 USDC base units for 676562 shares, exactly the controller outflow (maxWithdraw slot 205 = 5e12 did not bind). The defect is the v4 layout/initialisation mismatch with the live proxy storage, first reachable at the upgrade. Age: eth_getLogs Upgraded(address) topic0 0xbc7cd75a..2d3b on the proxy, blocks 0..16696240, returns three events: 0x21dbe7debd0ab102508cf03a055ece9056872e09 (block 15698164, creation), 0x582010c270ef877031e6b16554e51ca5bbda882e (block 15980084) and 0x80cb73074a6965f60df59bf8fa3ce398ffa2702c (block 16696143, tx index 221, log index 169, tx 0xab86672e..6712 from Safe signer 0xc3fd2bcb524af31963b3e3bb670f28ba14718244 through Safe 0x66945268093f28c28a2dce11a1640e06c070df7b execTransaction -> ProxyAdmin 0xd06ef24eb2da8b3e5a042da39ec303dd9162e0a6 upgrade(0xbdb5..d336, 0x80cb..702c); ProxyAdmin owner() = the Safe at block 16696239). EIP-1967 implementation slot = 0x80cb73.. and admin slot = 0xd06ef24e.. at block 16696239. Implementation code: empty at block 16690248, keccak 0xcd1356a9..8d71 at 16690249 (creation tx 0x1771c4d39781019f1cbc707292bcb0d4fd5b207d128ebdf0d45cb8f31c173afb by 0x86b94c96c3e6354e2d6bfc124bbae4425d3132f6), 16696143 and 16696239. Proxy code empty at 15698163 and keccak 0xfc1ea81d..3986 at 15698164 and 16696239; creation receipt 0x50e9aca4..0540 tx index 131 from 0x86b94c96.. with contractAddress = proxy. The upgrade was a project action through its Safe and ProxyAdmin, not attacker machinery. Earliest exercise: Etherscan V2 account.txlist for the proxy, blocks 16696143..16800000, lists only attacker redeem calls until 16726144: failed 0xd761f397.. (16696144), 0xeaa5d288.. (16696145), 0x645b6007.. (16696191), successful source-1 (16696240, index 15), failed 0xa58433c7.. (16696243), successful source-5 (16696260, index 1); later 0xde623977.. (16726144) by 0x592315d9.. failed. v4 onlyAllowed requires tx.origin == msg.sender while whiteList is zero, so the path cannot be reached through an internal call; source-1 is the first successful exercise.

Verified EFVault sources via Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode, chainid=1: 0x80cb73074a6965f60df59bf8fa3ce398ffa2702c (version 4.0, v0.8.3+commit.8d00100c; SHA-256 of returned SourceCode string 6a67c04d384d998c1a960ad9345b3ea2449c70138e5c14ac47a71ea8074151ab) and 0x582010c270ef877031e6b16554e51ca5bbda882e (version 3.0; SHA-256 17aeb56335a53c33706b9ab5f1e171eeb4fa1943d88b894c455895bfb4104af5). Compare contracts/core/Vault.sol state variable order and v4 redeem()/assetsPerShare().

Reviewed gross loss from receipt Transfer logs of USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 from controller 0xf491afe5101b2ee8abc1272fa8e2f85d68828396. Source-1 (block 16696240): log 103 3440359688 to fee recipient 0x39f4ef6294512015ab54ed3ab32baa1794e8de70, log 104 3436919328971 to 0x8b5a8333ec272c9bca1e43f4d009e9b2fad5efc9; burn log 105 676562 shares. Source-5 (block 16696260, same calldata): log 23 1720207383 fee, log 24 1718487176570 to the same receiver; burn log 25 676562. Total 5160567072612 base units (6 decimals) = 5160567.072612 USDC. The attacker EOA held 148236774 share units at block 16696239, accumulated through ordinary deposits before the upgrade; the 1353124 units burned were worth about 1.38 USDC at controller.totalAssets/totalSupply, not subtracted. No other successful redeem or withdraw on the proxy occurred between the upgrade and block 16800000.
